title: Optimal logarithmic mixing of the Thorp shuffle

result.label: Optimal logarithmic mixing of the Thorp shuffle
result.statement: Proves that the Thorp shuffle randomizes N=2^d labeled cards in ( N) physical shuffles, settling its optimal mixing order for power-of-two deck sizes. Convergence is in total variation from the worst initial ordering and concerns the entire permutation, not just individual card positions.
